newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press Digest - France - Le Monde March 27.
newsitem.headline: Press Digest - France - Le Monde March 27.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde:
-- Government expects current strike by junior doctors against tighter controls on health spending to lose momentum.
-- European Renault unions to demonstrate on Friday against planned shut-down of a Belgian assembly plant.
-- Bordeaux court blocks sale of part of Chateau d'Yquem to LVMH for technical reasons at the request of one of the owners.
-- Junior Trade Minister Yves Galland denies bill on fair trade practices has an inflationary effect on retail prices, as a marketing institute has said.
